announcements.headline: Unaudited Interim Results
announcements.insight: Tialis Essential IT publishes interim results following its August strategic agreement. Shareholders should monitor for execution details of this partnership.

announcements.headline: Strategic Agreement with AI Auxesis
announcements.insight: Tialis Essential IT has entered a strategic agreement with AI Auxesis. This follows the recent appointment of a nominated adviser and broker.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Nominated Adviser and Broker
announcements.insight: Tialis Essential IT appointed a Nominated Adviser and Broker. This board change marks the first such filing for the company.
